finding.claim: The r2b command (-k maps) selects only test_a_path_inside_a_namespace_maps_to_it. The refusal half of the row, a parent of an existing namespace exits 1 naming it, is tested by test_a_folder_holding_a_namespace_is_refused_naming_it, but the row's command never runs that test.

fixes.change: New tests: a root without .okf/ is refused and docs still works (f1); six processes opening the old store at once all exit 0 with no .partial left (f2, fails on the old code); the refusal test is named so r2b's -k maps runs it (f3); r1's test compares every section id of every page, not just the pages (f4).
